verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a set of editable SKILL.md prompt files installed into a coding agent. It has no hosted API, accounts, or credential system, so issuing scoped API keys to an agent is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any credential-issuing capability; the runtime probe even describes the install as keyless.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
